fieldValues.title: Every level runs the same intake cycle
fieldValues.decision_question: Do the programme, groups and sub-groups handle requests the same way?
fieldValues.context: D2 of clerk#57 (plans/wg-srs-operations.md, section 8), asked of the owner since 2026-10-12. Recorded as a proposed decision on 2026-10-16 so a session can take it: until now it existed only as PR text, which no session agenda reads.
fieldValues.decision_statement: We work as if every level (programme, group, sub-group) runs the same intake cycle: receive, place, assess, propose, decide, report.
fieldValues.rationale: One shape at every level lets each level reuse the same tools and agenda; only what it looks across changes (proposal section 3).
fieldValues.revisit_when: A level needs a step the others do not.
